old_obligation: W01 represents one Standard Model generation by Hom(l + l^perp, S_R + S_L), whose SU(3)xSU(2)_LxU(1) decomposition reproduces the listed quark/lepton transformation roles including a right-handed neutrino. The printed one-generation representation is (C_-1 direct-sum C3_(+1/3)) tensor (C2_0 direct-sum C_-1 direct-sum C_+1) with six displayed components C2_-1, C_-2, C_0, (C3 tensor C2)_(+1/3), C3_(-2/3), C3_(+4/3), in that order. The author maps these respectively to the left lepton doublet, e_R, right neutrino, left quark doublet, u_R, d_R; the source's printed component order and signed U(1) weights are retained without reinterpretation.
